description: Write scripts/parse-curriculum.mjs to parse all non-empty curriculum .md files and produce src/data/curriculumData.js with the full curriculumMap (mathematics B7 data merged/preserved from the existing file, all other subjects parsed from their .md files).
steps: 1. READ src/data/curriculumData.js in full to capture the existing mathematics B7 and science B7 data exactly as it is — this is the merge baseline.

2. CREATE c:\Users\KING\number-academy\scripts\parse-curriculum.mjs as an ESM Node script using only built-in modules (fs, path, url). At the top of the file resolve __dirname via import.meta.url + fileURLToPath.

4. Implement the parseFile(filePath) function with this line-by-line state machine:
   - Variables: currentStrand=null, currentSubStrand=null, currentCS=null, currentIndicator=null, strands=[]
   - Skip preamble lines before the first '# STRAND' heading (the header table, NOTES section, CONTENTS table).
   - '# STRAND ...' line (starts with '# ' and contains 'STRAND'): extract strand number and title after the colon. Push a new strand object { id:'strand-N', code:'N', title:'TITLE', subStrands:[] }. Reset currentSubStrand, currentCS, currentIndicator to null.
   - '## SUB-STRAND ...' line (starts with '## '): extract sub-strand number+title after colon. The number may be fractional (e.g. 'B7.1'). Use a sequential counter ss_n within the strand. Push { id:'ss-strandCode-N', code:'strandCode.N', title:'TITLE', contentStandards:[] }.
   - '### Content Standard CODE' or '### Content Standard ...' (starts with '### '): extract the CODE (the first token after '### Content Standard ' — or if '### Content Standard' is absent, use the whole heading text as code). Store as currentCS = { id:CODE, code:CODE, description:'', indicators:[] }. Push onto currentSubStrand.contentStandards.
   - '**...**' bold line immediately after a ### heading (and before the first #### heading): strip the '**' markers, trim. Append to currentCS.description. Multiple bold lines may appear — concatenate with ' '.
   - '#### Indicator CODE' (starts with '#### '): extract CODE from the heading (stop at double-space or '*(printed' or end of meaningful text). Strip the '*(printed in the curriculum as...)*' parenthetical. Create currentIndicator = { id:CODE, code:CODE, description:'' } and push onto currentCS.indicators. Inline description text on the same line after the code (some files inline it) goes into description.
   - Plain text paragraph line (no leading '#', not bold, not a list, not a table row): if currentIndicator exists and description not yet populated from a bold line, append to currentIndicator.description (trimmed). Stop appending at the next '**Exemplars**', '**Core competencies**', '- CC', '- CP', '- CI', '- DL', '- PL', '- CG' lines.
   - '---' separator: do nothing (reset indicator capture state only).
   - Return strands array (may be empty if the file was a stub).
5. Write the slugify helper: replace non-alphanumeric runs with '-', lowercase. Used only for strand/sub-strand IDs for non-code-based subjects.
6. Call parseFile for each entry in FILE_MAP and build parsedData[subjectId][classId] = strands[].

7. Define HARDCODED_MATH as the verbatim mathematics B7 object from the existing curriculumData.js (copy it directly as a JS value — do not re-parse). Set parsedData.mathematics = { B7: HARDCODED_MATH }.

8. Define the full subjects array (10 entries in this order): mathematics, science, english, socialStudies, computing, rme, careerTech, creativeArts, french, ghanaianLanguage — each with { id, label }. Labels: 'Mathematics','Science','English','Social Studies','Computing','RME','Career Technology','Creative Arts','French','Ghanaian Language'.
9. Define classes array: [{ id:'B7', label:'Basic 7' }, { id:'B8', label:'Basic 8' }, { id:'B9', label:'Basic 9' }].

10. Serialise to JS: write the output file as: `export const subjects = [...]; export const classes = [...]; export const curriculumMap = { ... };` using JSON.stringify for the map value embedded in a template literal. The output must be valid ES module syntax.
11. At the end of the script, print a summary: for each subject+class, log `subject classId: N strands` (even zeros for empty stubs).
acceptance_criteria: `node --check src/data/curriculumData.js` exits 0 with no syntax errors.
curriculumData.js exports subjects (10 entries), classes (3 entries), curriculumMap.
curriculumMap.mathematics.B7 is identical to the pre-existing data (same strand codes, indicator IDs, indicator descriptions).
curriculumMap.science.B7 has at least 5 strands with indicators (parsed from CCP_SCIENCE_JHS_2023_Basic7_Full.md).
curriculumMap.creativeArts.B7 equals [] (empty — stub file produces no strands).
curriculumMap.mathematics.B8 equals [] or is absent (CCP_MATHEMATICS stubs are empty).
French and Ghanaian Language have non-empty strand arrays for all three classes.
Running `npm run build` still succeeds after the file is updated.
verification: npm run build  (must complete without errors)
